info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Streaming Subscriptions API allows users to terminate active streaming subscriptions effectively. This API provides capability for businesses to quickly manage subscription lifecycles, enabling the cancellation of services as per customer requests. Typical consumers include developers managing subscription services or customer support teams addressing client inquiries. By utilizing this endpoint, applications can ensure that users have control over their subscriptions, fostering better customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an active subscription. Once canceled, the subscription will no longer be charged at the end of the current billing cycle. Ensure to handle any necessary cleanup or user notifications related to the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a subscription. It requires the specific details necessary to process the cancellation request as defined in the schema.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a subscription operation.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the cancellation operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier indicating the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription after the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Any additional message or information about the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation request.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for the cancellation of subscriptions.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation request was initiated automatically.

Audit.description: Audit details for tracking the creation of the cancellation request.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
